items.description: If you are new to eBPF, you may want to try the links described as "introductions" in this section.

items.title: A BPF reference guide
items.description: About BPF C and bcc Python helpers, from bcc repository.

items.title: Beginner's guide to eBPF
items.description: A set of live-coding talks and the accompanying code examples, introducing eBPF programming using a variety of libraries and program types.

items.title: Generic eBPF Presentations and Articles
eXpress Data Path (XDP)
items.description: The first presentation about XDP.

items.title: All XDP details in a technical paper: The eXpress Data Path: Fast Programmable Packet Processing in the Operating System Kernel
items.description: , by Toke Høiland-Jørgensen, Jesper Dangaard Brouer, Daniel Borkmann, John Fastabend, Tom Herbert, David Ahern and David Miller, all being essential eBPF and XDP contributors.

items.title: hBPF - eBPF in hardware
items.description: An eBPF CPU written for FPGAs.

items.title: OpenCSD eBPF SSD offloading
items.description: Computational Storage simulation (QEMU) platform with FUSE LFS filesystem for Zoned Namespaces NVMe SSDs using uBPF for compute kernel offloading, all in userspace.

items.title: bcc Reference Guide
items.description: Many incremental steps to start using bcc and eBPF, mostly centered on tracing and monitoring.

items.title: bcc Python Developer Tutorial
items.description: Comes with bcc, but targets the Python bits across seventeen "lessons".

items.title: XDP Hands-On Tutorial
items.description: A progressive (three levels of difficulty) tutorial to learn how to process packets with XDP.

items.title: Linux Tracing Workshops Materials
items.description: Involves the use of several BPF tools for tracing.

items.title: bcc/examples
items.description: Examples coming along with the bcc tools, mostly about tracing.

items.title: bcc/tools
items.description: These tools themselves can be seen as example use cases for BPF programs, mostly for tracing and monitoring. bcc tools have been packaged for some Linux distributions.

items.title: redbpf examples
items.description: Example programs for using RedBPF to write eBPF programs in Rust.

items.title: prototype-kernel/kernel/samples/bpf
items.description: Jesper Dangaard Brouer's prototype-kernel repository contains some additional examples that can be compiled outside of kernel infrastructure.

items.title: Netronome sample network applications
items.description: Provides basic but complete examples of eBPF applications also compatible with hardware offload.

items.title: ebpf-samples
items.description: A collection of compiled (as ELF object files) samples gathered from several projects, primarily intended to serve as test cases for user space verifiers.

items.title: XDP/TC-eBPF example
items.description: Program that uses XDP/TC-eBPF to provide statefull firewalling and socket redirection.

items.title: MPLSinIP sample
items.description: A heavily commented sample demonstrating how to encapsulate and decapsulate MPLS within IP. The code is commented for those new to BPF development.

items.title: ebpf-kill-example
items.description: A fully documented and tested example of an eBPF probe that logs all force-kills and prints them out in user-space.

items.title: bcc
items.description: Framework and set of tools - One way to handle BPF programs, in particular for tracing and monitoring. Also includes some utilities that may help inspect maps or programs on the system.

items.title: Lua front-end for BCC
items.description: Another alternative to C, and even to most of the Python code used in bcc.

items.title: libbpf
items.description: A C library used for handling BPF objects (programs and maps), and manipulating ELF object files containing them. It is shipped with the kernel and mirrored on GitHub.

items.title: libbpf-bootstrap
items.description: Scaffolding for BPF application development with libbpf and BPF CO-RE.

items.title: cilium/ebpf
items.description: Pure-Go library to read, modify and load eBPF programs and attach them to various hooks in the Linux kernel.

items.title: libbpfgo
items.description: eBPF library for Go, powered by libbpf.

items.title: aya
items.description: A pure Rust library for writing, loading, and managing eBPF objects, with a focus on developer experience and operability. It supports writing eBPF programs in Rust and distributing library code over crates.io to share it between eBPF programs. Aya does not depend on libbpf.

items.title: aya-template
items.description: Templates for writing BPF applications in Aya that can be used with .

items.title: rbpf
items.description: Written in Rust. Interpreter for Linux, macOS and Windows, and JIT-compiler for x86_64 under Linux.

items.title: uBPF
items.description: Written in C. Contains an interpreter, a JIT compiler for x86_64 architecture, an assembler and a disassembler.

items.title: PREVAIL
items.description: A user space verifier for eBPF using an abstract interpretation layer, with support for loops.

items.title: A generic implementation
items.description: With support for FreeBSD kernel, FreeBSD user space, Linux kernel, Linux user space and macOS user space. Used for the VALE software switch's BPF extension module.

items.title: bpfcompat
items.description: Boots real Linux kernels in disposable QEMU/KVM VMs to load- and attach-validate compiled eBPF objects across a multi-distro, multi-architecture kernel matrix, classifying failures (missing BTF, unsupported map/program type, CO-RE relocations); runs as a CI gate and GitHub Action.

items.title: Cilium
items.description: project (GitHub repository) is a technology relying on eBPF and XDP to provide "fast in-kernel networking and security policy enforcement for containers based on eBPF programs generated on the fly". Many presentations available (with overlap):

items.title: ApFree WiFiDog
items.description: A high performance and lightweight captive portal solution for wireless networks. It leverages eBPF for traffic control and deep packet inspection capabilities, with plans to gradually replace nftables firewall functionality with eBPF-based solutions.

items.title: merbridge
items.description: Use eBPF to speed up your Service Mesh. Merbridge replaces iptables rules with eBPF to intercept traffic. It also combines msg_redirect to reduce latency with a shortened datapath between sidecars and services.

items.title: ipx_wrap
items.description: A proof-of-concept IPX implementation for Linux using eBPF.

items.title: P4 has some interactions with eBPF:
Suricata, an open source intrusion detection system, relies on eBPF components for its "capture bypass" features:

children.title: SEPTun-Mark-II
children.description: Extreme Performance Tuning guide - Mark II.

items.title: Coroot
items.description: Coroot is an open-source APM and observability tool, a DataDog and NewRelic alternative.

items.title: pixie
items.description: Observability for Kubernetes using eBPF. Features include protocol tracing, application profiling, and support for distributed bpftrace deployments.

items.title: kyanos
items.description: Kyanos is an eBPF-based network issue analysis tool that enables you to capture network requests, such as HTTP, Redis, and MySQL requests.

items.title: Hubble
items.description: Network, service and security observability for Kubernetes using eBPF.

items.title: DeepFlow
items.description: Instant observability for cloud-native and AI applications based on eBPF.

items.title: Caretta
items.description: Instant Kubernetes service dependency map generated by eBPF, right to a Grafana instance.

items.title: InKeV: In-Kernel Distributed Network Virtualization for DCN
parca-agent
items.description: eBPF based always-on continuous profiler for analysis of CPU and memory usage, down to the line number and throughout time.

items.title: SkyWalking Rover
items.description: Apache SkyWalking is an open-source Application Performance Monitoring (APM) platform specially designed for distributed systems with microservices, cloud-native and container-based (Kubernetes) architectures. SkyWalking Rover is an eBPF-based profiler and metrics collector for C, C++, Golang, and Rust applications.

items.title: rbperf
items.description: Sampling profiler and tracer for Ruby.

items.title: kpod-metrics
items.description: eBPF-based pod-level kernel metrics collector for Kubernetes. Exports per-pod CPU, network, memory, syscall, disk I/O, and L7 protocol metrics to Prometheus. BPF programs are defined using a Kotlin DSL instead of C.

items.title: eTraceGen
items.description: eTraceGen is a Linux telemetry engine built with eBPF and Modern C++ that captures kernel-level events for processes, files, system calls, and network with a modular pipeline for decoding, enrichment, filtering, and JSON output.

items.title: rstat
items.description: Sub-millisecond system monitoring using eBPF tracepoints on sched_switch, sched_process_exit, and sched_process_free, with zero heap allocations in steady state.

items.title: Ingero
items.description: eBPF-based GPU causal observability agent. Traces CUDA Runtime and Driver APIs via uprobes and host kernel events via tracepoints to build causal chains explaining GPU latency, with <2% overhead.

items.title: Tetragon
items.description: Kubernetes-aware, eBPF-based security observability and runtime enforcement.

items.title: Tracee
items.description: A runtime security and forensics tool for Linux which uses eBPF technology to trace the system and applications at runtime, and analyze collected events to detect suspicious behavioral patterns.

items.title: Sysmon for Linux
items.description: A security monitoring tool. It depends on SysinternalsEBPF.

items.title: owLSM
items.description: Open source agent that implements a stateful Sigma rules engine focused on monitoring and prevention using eBPF LSM.

items.title: harpoon
items.description: Trace syscalls from user-space functions, by using eBPF.

items.title: bpflock - Lock Linux machines
items.description: An eBPF driven security tool for locking and auditing Linux machines.

items.title: redcanary-ebpf-sensor
items.description: A set of BPF programs that gather security relevant event data from the Linux kernel. The BPF programs are combined into a single ELF file from which individual probes can be selectively loaded, depending on the running operating system and kernel version.

items.title: BPFJailer
items.description: BpfJailer is an eBPF-based process jailing system that provides mandatory access control (MAC) for Linux.

items.title: Bombini
items.description: An eBPF-based security agent written entirely in Rust using the Aya library and built on LSM (Linux Security Module) BPF hooks.

items.title: Synapse
items.description: Extended detection and response (XDR) with eBPF-powered firewall and proxy, to protect your Linux servers.

items.title: Inner Warden
items.description: A self-defending security agent for Linux and macOS that uses eBPF with 22 kernel hooks (tracepoints, kprobes, LSM, XDP) via the Aya library for real-time threat detection, automated response, and AI-powered triage.

items.title: scx
items.description: sched_ext schedulers and tools.

items.title: Gthulhu
items.description: Gthulhu optimizes cloud-native workloads using the Linux Scheduler Extension for different application scenarios.

items.title: oryx
items.description: A TUI for sniffing network traffic using eBPF on Linux.

items.title: kubectl trace
items.description: A kubectl plug-in for executing bpftrace programs in a Kubernetes cluster.

items.title: redbpf
items.description: Tooling and framework to write eBPF code in Rust efficiently.

items.title: ptcpdump
items.description: A process-aware, eBPF-based tcpdump-like tool.

items.title: bpfman
items.description: An eBPF Manager for Linux and Kubernetes. Includes a built-in program loader that supports program cooperation for XDP and TC programs, as well as deployment of eBPF programs from OCI images.

items.title: AgentSight
items.description: Zero-instrumentation eBPF observability for LLM and coding agents, capturing syscall-level traces (file, network, process) without modifying the agent.

items.title: bpfd
items.description: Framework for running BPF programs with rules on Linux as a daemon. Container aware.

items.title: adeb
items.description: A Linux shell environment for using tracing tools on Android with BPFd.

items.title: upf-bpf
items.description: An in-kernel solution based on XDP for 5G UPF.

items.title: GhostScope
items.description: A DWARF-aware eBPF tracer for source-level userspace tracing, with an interactive TUI and a scriptable CLI.

items.title: BPFd
items.description: A distinct BPF daemon, trying to leverage the flexibility of the bcc tools to trace and debug remote targets, and in particular devices running with Android.

items.title: ebpf-explorer
items.description: A web interface to explore system's maps and programs.

items.title: ebpfmon
items.description: A TUI (terminal user interface) application for real time monitoring of eBPF programs.

items.title: ActPlane
items.description: OS-level agent harness that compiles a policy DSL to an in-kernel eBPF engine for labeled information-flow control at the syscall boundary, enforcing constraints across any tool or subprocess.

items.title: greggd
items.description: System daemon to compile and load eBPF programs into the kernel, and forward program output to socket for metric aggregation.
